MRK.rationale: MRK is a high-quality pharmaceutical franchise (Keytruda, Gardasil, animal health) with strong Q1 2026 revenue growth (+5% YoY) and active pipeline investment. However, the stock is fundamentally unattractive at current levels on all three pillars. Pillar 1 (fundamentals): Q1 2026 operating income collapsed from +$5.90B to -$3.53B, producing a net loss of -$4.24B (EPS -$1.72). While operating cash flow remained positive ($3.92B, +56.7% YoY), suggesting non-cash charges, the magnitude of the operating expense increase (~$9B) is extreme and unexplained. Net margin fell to 13.6% and ROE to 19.5%, both at 365-day floors. Pillar 2 (valuation): The stock trades at peak multiples — PE 33.4x (365d ceiling), P/B 6.5x (365d ceiling) — for trough earnings power. The 3% earnings yield sits below the 10-year Treasury yield of 4.45%, providing no valuation floor. The market is paying maximum prices for minimum profitability. Pillar 3 (catalyst): No credible near-term re-rating catalyst exists. The Q1 charge is unexplained and Q2 2026 filings are needed to clarify; the Trodelvy-Keytruda trial discontinuation (2026-06-09) is a minor negative; the Moderna melanoma vaccine data (2026-06-01) is a long-term positive but not a near-term re-rating event. The stock has rallied ~58% off its low while fundamentals deteriorated — price is moving against the fundamental path, not with it.
